meta.name: google-maps-contact-extract
meta.description: Extracts business contact details from Google Maps search results and place detail pages, then visits each business website to collect emails, phone numbers, and social media profiles (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Discord). Use when user mentions Google Maps contact extraction, maps email scraper, business lead generation from Google Maps, find emails from maps, scrape Google Maps businesses, maps business contacts, get phone from Google Maps, social media from maps listing, competitor research from maps, local business contact list, maps data export, google maps scraper, extract contacts from google maps, find business email google, gmaps leads, maps email finder, or wants to replicate Google Maps business data extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图提取商家联系信息并收集社交媒体资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从谷歌地图批量获取商家联系方式用于销售或市场调研。
copy.tagline_en: Extract business contacts from Google Maps and collect social media profiles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to bulk collect business contact details from Google Maps for sales or market research.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你指定的关键词和地点，从 Google Maps 搜索商家列表，再逐个访问商家网站，提取邮箱、电话和社交媒体账号（如 Facebook、Instagram 等），最后汇总成一份联系人表格。
howto.when: 当你提到“提取 Google Maps 联系人”、“地图邮箱抓取”、“商家线索生成”等关键词，或要求从 Google Maps 获取商家联系方式时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取纽约咖啡店的邮箱和电话。
从 Google Maps 抓取洛杉矶前20家披萨店的社交媒体链接。
say.note: Claude 会搜索披萨店，提取社交媒体账号。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can search Google Maps by keyword and location, extract business listings, then visit each business website to collect emails, phone numbers, and social media profiles (e.g., Facebook, Instagram), and return a merged dataset.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "extract Google Maps contacts", "maps email scraper", "business lead generation from Google Maps", or ask to get contact details from Google Maps businesses.

say_en.text: Extract emails and phones of coffee shops in New York.
say_en.note: Claude will search and collect contacts from each website.

say_en.text: Scrape social media links of top 20 pizza places in Los Angeles from Google Maps.
say_en.note: Claude will search and extract social media profiles.
